claims.assertion: Mari Swa says the Pleiades have eleven civilizations; Taygetans occupy four planets and are Lyrian-humanlike Federation members.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: She says Andromedans, Arcturians, and Lyrians founded the Federation; Andromedan ship Viera is its local headquarters.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: She says Antarians and Centauri belong to the Federation, while Ummites and Karistus do not.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: She says reptilians range from animal-like forms to alpha Draconians, with both hostile and peaceful varieties.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: She says many extraterrestrial races protect humanity discreetly but generally avoid solving human problems, amid debate over intervention.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

coverage_gaps: The overview also describes many individual species, physical traits, home systems, and historical claims.
